final: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(acc.avg_amt) AS figure FROM acc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.figure, reg.figure - overall.avg_figure AS excess, reg.figure / overall.avg_figure AS ratio FROM reg, overall WHERE reg.figure > overall.avg_figure ORDER BY reg.figure DESC
